label: Apollonius circle in the Last Supper
statement: Leonardo embedded the constructive properties of the Apollonius circle in the composition of the Last Supper.
scope: Geometric construction layer of the three layer analysis model. Claims of correspondence with the symbol and attribute layer or the painted surface layer belong to the interpretive layer.
falsified_if: Proposed by Claude, for the researcher to accept or replace: on a rectified, high resolution image that accounts for losses and restoration, the points used in the construction do not satisfy the Apollonius ratio within the stated measurement error.

Proposed by Claude: physical traces documented in technical studies of the mural (incisions, the nail hole at the vanishing point, underdrawing) are incompatible with the proposed construction sequence.
Proposed by Claude: an equal or higher rate of fit is obtained for comparable point sets in control compositions of the period (base rate test), so the fit does not distinguish the Last Supper.
open_questions: Which edition or transmission of Apollonius, or of a text reporting the circle property, could Leonardo or Pacioli have known in Milan in the 1490s?
Define the measurement protocol and the image source before any fit is computed, so the test cannot be tuned after the fact.
